teacher_reference: validated development formal MultiPV=1, go nodes 1000000
eligibility: normal classified positions with at least four legal moves
aggregation: mean of five per-game hit proportions
pilot: canonical development pilot subset intersected with eligibility; three repetitions
incomplete_top3: invalid measurement, never silently dropped from denominator
tie_policy: exact USI move membership in the three reported legal distinct roots; no tie expansion
candidate_selection: last complete depth must provide MultiPV slots 1,2,3 and match bestmove
